changes: Screensharing (/ss <player>): Switched IRC request transport to PRIVMSG, ensuring spectator requests reliably deliver to target player with [ACCEPT] and [DENY] buttons
Synchronized Lyrics (/b lyrics & /lyrics): Word-for-word and line-by-line synchronized lyrics GUI powered by LRCLIB, featuring smooth auto-scrolling and cyan glowing karaoke word highlights
Spotify HUD Redesign: Redesigned dark plum card (#1E1324) with official Spotify icon, neon cyan controls (|◀ ⏸ ▶|), and track progress bar

Spotify Accuracy & Fixes: Fixed playback timer desync and progress resetting to 0:00 on pause via Windows GSMTC media tracking; added clickable song & artist search links; kept HUD visible in inventory
Storage Overlay Crash Fix: Removed SlotAccessor mixin and switched to direct memory offsets for slot positioning, completely preventing classload crashes
Spectator Hand & Body Rendering: Overrode camera entity in LevelExtractor to prevent Minecraft culling client player body from the world, and suppressed client hand in first-person spectator
Hoppity Call Filter: Gated auto-pickup strictly to calls from Hoppity, preventing accidental pickup of Vincent or other NPC calls
Changelog Colors: Fixed changelog text turning white after §ka by using §r§7 to maintain proper readable gray formatting
Screensharing (/ss <player>): In-game mod-to-mod spectator request with interactive [ACCEPT] and [DENY] buttons, auto-accept whitelist (/ss whitelist <player>), and clean disconnects (/ss stop)
Spotify HUD Overlay: Interactive music HUD showing track name, artist, progress timer, and clickable controls (⏮, ⏯, ⏭) via background media keys
Storage Overlay Reliability: Fixed container screen launching using setScreenAndShow, reliably opening multi-grid storage overlay on /storage, backpacks, and ender chests
Spectator Hand & Item: Spectating in first-person cleanly renders the spectated player's arm skin and held item with full bobbing and animations
100 Hearts Spectator Fix: Eliminated the massive multi-row hearts bar bug when spectating players with high max HP on Hypixel
Spectated Held Item Name: Displays the spectated player's held item name and rarity color above the hotbar
Spectator Camera Smoothing: Eliminated look jitter and stutter during spectator camera by cleaning mouse delta handling
Discord IPC Permissions: Gated Discord IPC on discordHudEnabled so Discord never prompts for permissions on startup when disabled
No Obfuscate Label: Fixed scrambling formatting in config so §ka§7 renders with scrambled 'a' and clean parenthesis
Storage Overlay: Fixed custom storage overlay failing to open on storage menus, backpacks, and ender chests
Discord Voice HUD: Added in-game voice call overlay showing speaking indicators and active screenshares, accessible with /ss and /b ss
Spectator Camera: Camera now turns when the spectated player looks around, and displays their arm skin and held item in first-person
Player Body Visibility: Your own player model and armor layers remain visible in the world during spectator and freecam
Text Jitter Fix: Completely stopped recombobulated item titles from shaking horizontally when No Obfuscate is enabled
Clean Mayor Chat: Removed broken emoji and underlines from mayor announcements and perks while preserving hover tooltips
Version Fix: Resolved /b version showing 'unknown' in development environments
Storage Overlay: shifted injection to concrete static MenuScreens.create in MenuScreensConstructorMixin, reliably opening StorageOverlayScreen on /storage, ender chests, and backpacks
Stable Obfuscated Glyphs: FontMixin stabilizes §k§r character advance to target width, stopping rarity-upgraded item titles from jittering/shaking
No Obfuscate Config Label: fixed unclosed §k§r formatting code so the closing parenthesis is properly displayed in config GUI
Brigadier /b mayor: registered mayor subcommand in Brigadier tree, fixing 'Incorrect argument for command at position 2: b'
Area & Subarea: /b area now displays parent area and subarea together (e.g. Hub (Village))
Player Body in Spectator: LevelExtractorMixin and AvatarRendererMixin prevent culling and ensure full player body & layer rendering while spectating
Hoppity Call Auto-Pickup: automatically answers incoming Hoppity phone calls (BUZZ... [PICK UP]) on the very first buzz
Storage Overlay: intercepted MenuScreens.ScreenConstructor.fromPacket matching Skyblocker architecture to reliably construct and open the searchable multi-grid overlay
Interactive Mayor Tooltips: hovering Mayor Diaz displays exact Hypixel calendar GUI tooltip layout with perks list; individual perks show full descriptions; minister shows active perk; added /b mayor
Live Mayor RTCA Integration: server and client incorporate live active mayor in RTCA boost calculations (e.g. Mayor: Diaz (+0%)) and remove mayor from uncounted list
Spectator Camera Decoupling: SpectatorCamManager decouples mouse rotation during /b cam from the spectated player's body and head pose
Player World Rendering in Spectator: LevelExtractorMixin allows LocalPlayer extraction so player body remains fully rendered in the world when spectating
Dungeon Quick Join: /f1-f7, /m1-m7, and /e now dispatch uppercase instance identifiers (CATACOMBS_FLOOR_SEVEN, etc.) with chat feedback
Scoreboard Subarea: enhanced detection of Private Use Area glyphs in scoreboard lines (-  Village) in /b subarea and /b area
Keypad Keybinds: removed keypad keys from modifier combo prefixes, allowing Keypad arrows and numbers to be bound directly
IRC Plaintext IP: Updated chat server connection endpoint

RTCA Live Boosts: bomboapi server now scans player inventory sync data for highest Hecatomb helmet equipped or in wardrobe, Scarf accessory (Grimoire +6%, Thesis +4%, Studies +2%), and Catacombs Graduate shards (milestones 1..10 = 2%..20%)
Interactive RTCA Chat: in-place chat update via GuiMessage replacement in mc.gui.hud.getChat(), eliminating duplicate chat lines while resolving chips

Storage Overlay: fixed container title recognition (stripped color codes, bare Ender Chest, Spanish Cofre de Ender, storage (1/2), and backpacks without #), containerMenu assignment ordering, and dynamic backpack discovery on open
Backpack Preview Layering: StoragePreviewManager hover preview renders on top of custom inventory buttons and item lists in InventoryScreen
IDE Dev Client Clipboard: prevented headless AWT mode on initialization, added GLFW modifier key fallbacks in EditBoxMixin, and added retry loops for Windows system clipboard locks
Spectator / Camera: enabled full mouse rotation in /b cam spectator mode and ensured player body model remains rendered
Dungeons: /f1-f7, /m1-m7, and /e now use joininstance catacombs_floor_<name> and catacombs_entrance
ESP: expanded bounding box for starred mob detection in dungeons and added automatic coordinate detection for F4/M4 Thorn etherwarp helper at (27, 81, 18)
Scoreboard: enhanced subarea parsing for dash-prefixed lines (- Your Island) in /b subarea and /b area

Chat Imgur Delete / Supr Fix: fixed issue where selecting text in chat and pressing Delete (Supr) or Backspace would trigger an Imgur upload and paste $imgur if an image was in the clipboard; removed empty insertText check and ensured clipboard image paste only triggers on Ctrl+V in focused input
Documentation: AGENTS.md and docs/HANDOFF_KNOWLEDGE.md now cover v26.2.28.45 and v26.2.28.46 with an explicit Tested vs. Untested split

New Priority 0 test queue: in-game verification of the RTCA hover chips - replacement not duplication, exact levels, the honest +10% boost with its 'Not counted' line, fractional class average, the first-hover loading placeholder and the 60s cache

Server knowledge captured: the exactLevel = level + into/need fix (classProgress().into is remaining XP, not a fraction), the self-referential boost.label crash that 502'd /api/v1/dungeons, and the xpForNextLevel-is-a-total trap

False alarms recorded so they are not 'fixed' again: a stale cold_efficiency: 1 profile snapshot (live value is 5, all perks really are tier 5) and the assumeBestCase code-path difference that looked like a caching bug
MC 26.2 API notes: use Style.EMPTY (no no-arg Style constructor) and a literal class colour code array (ChatFormatting.getChar does not exist)
Quirks recorded: the bombofabric -> bomboFabric remote rename, that docs/CODE_STYLE.md does not exist, and the write-locally-then-scp rule for server patches
Known outstanding: top-level classAverage in /api/v1/dungeons/class-average still returns the integer 48 instead of the exact 48.47

RTCA Boost Honesty: stopped defaulting unverifiable boosts to their maximum - Hecatomb X (+4%), Grimoire scarf (+6%) and Catacombs Graduate (+20%) were being invented on every real player lookup, inflating each class to a flat +40%
Verified Boosts Only: RTCA now reports only what Hypixel actually exposes (the five class essence perks from player_data.perks); unverifiable gear is counted as 0 and listed as not counted
Impact: M7 XP/run corrected 420,000 to 330,000 and the Class Average 50 estimate for bomboclas corrected 1,070 to 1,361 runs
Tooltip Honesty: class hover tooltips now end with a 'Not counted' line naming Hecatomb, Scarf, Catacombs Graduate and Mayor as unknown rather than assumed
Calculator Preserved: /dungeons still opens with best-case defaults via an explicit assumeBestCase opt-in instead of being the silent default on every endpoint

RTCA Hover Chat: BomboBot's flat [RTCA50] line is intercepted in ChatMixin and rebuilt as interactive MutableComponents; each class is a hoverable chip showing runs to max, XP to next level, XP per run, and the full boost breakdown (perk tier, Hecatomb, scarf, Graduate, Global, Mayor)
RTCA Exact Class Average: class levels and the class average now show exact fractional values (e.g. Archer 48.92, CA 48.47) instead of truncating to integers
RTCA Formatting: removed the trailing flat '|  | Boost: ...' block from the in-game chat line; the header is now compact and all boost detail lives in the hover tooltips
Server: /command/rtca and /command/dungeons expose exactLevel, xpToNextLevel, xpPerRun, runsToMax and a per-class boost breakdown; API responses are cached 60s per player in the client
Storage Overlay: full port of Skyblocker multi-grid storage overlay, replacing /storage, ender chest, and backpack menus with a compact searchable multi-grid interface
Multi-Grid Search: live item query filtering across all ender chests and backpacks simultaneously
Configurable Settings: customizable storages per row, backpack columns, remember search, remember last opened backpack, and mouse cursor position preservation
Live Inventory Synchronization: dynamic slot updates, container item caching with NBT, base64, and custom player head texture support
Camera & Spectator: clamped camera FOV to options FOV (110) during /b cam and freecam via GameRendererMixin, eliminating sprint distortion and lerp lag

Auto Croesus: uses instabuy for keys/kismets and instasell for items; resolves live Bazaar prices for Bank/NPNG/Jerry books without hardcoded fallbacks; removed profit threshold gate; redesigned profit HUD to clean text with shadows and no background box
Dungeon Profit Tracking: deduplicates runs on disk/load; full itemized hover tooltip in /b profit; decoupled profit sync authentication completely from Hoppity egg auth (using UUID + Bombo API key)

Commands & Profile Viewer: separated /b area and /b subarea; added /b pv1, /b pv2, and /b pvconfig shortcuts; added gear settings button in Profile Viewer header; multi-profile support via all_profiles and ?profile= param

Storage & Eggs: purged empty slots from storageData on container open (eliminating phantom items like Backpack 10 Divan's Drill); added Island Chests tab to /b storage; added Spanish/localized chest titles; egg finder unsubscribes on private islands/garden/limbo/dungeons and removes only single closest waypoint on collection

Values & UI: EIV discrepancy fixes (reforge stones, blacksmith apply costs, etherwarp, power scrolls, tuners); added Insta Buy / Insta Sell / Both toggle; suppressed HUD on InventoryScreen; /b apihistory masks sensitive tokens; config sliders accept direct numeric entry; client brand cleanly reports mod ID
Freecam: interpolated per-frame movement using render delta partial ticks eliminates 20Hz jitter; FOV modifier clamped to 1.0 during freecam to avoid distortion
Flavors & Security: removed flavor switching entirely ('Switch Flavor' button and /b update switch); completely removed brand spoofing and stealth mode

Automation & Dungeons: AutoCroesus accounts for dungeon chest keys (live pricing/threshold, spent check); DungeonChestProfitHud displays coin + key breakdown; new dedicated /b profit GUI with run statistics, breakdown, and itemized runs; removed obsolete profit sync 404 endpoint and resolved 401s; ultimate enchantment prices resolved accurately

Auth & APIs: separated Aaron token (hysky.de WebSocket) and Bombo token (api.bombo.dpdns.org); Profile Viewer sends BomboAddons User-Agent and logs queries to ApiHistory; ApiHistoryScreen scrolls to latest entries initially

Fixes & QoL: chat history locraw tracking stamped correctly; /b area strips PUA unicode glyphs and prints Area / Subarea; storage chest waypoints render through walls and refresh on container close; EggFinder island mapping corrected; /b cmd terminates process tree on interrupt and supports text drag selection/copy/paste; AOTV model fallback fixed to diamond shovel; ported player head skin rendering fix; decoupled tooltip value additions; sliders support typed text with coin abbreviations; /b item suggests SkyBlock item IDs

Fixed tooltip rendering crashes caused by modifying immutable ItemStack tooltip lists: SupercraftHelper now copies lines into a mutable ArrayList before applying configured additions, and the ItemStack mixin returns the updated list safely
Freecam: your own body stays visible while freecam is active - the entity render-cull chain no longer drops the player model once the camera is detached from it
Freecam: the F3 position block (XYZ / Block / Chunk / Facing / Dimension) now reports the freecam camera, tagged '(freecam camera)', instead of the player's coordinates
The legit build can no longer install the cheat build: the 'Switch Flavor' button is gone from General and /b update switch explains that this build always stays on the legit artifact
Groundwork: cheat modules now live in their own source tree (src/cheat/java) and freecam is routed through the flavor SPI, so shared camera, mouse and keyboard mixins no longer name a cheat class
Sequences: every step row has an [ON]/[OFF] switch - a disabled step stays in the list but is skipped during playback; TAB moves focus from a step field to the GUI/Container name field
Sliders can be typed into: clicking a slider's numeric label turns it into a text field; coin sliders (100K - 3M) are used by the Auto Croesus key/kismet thresholds

Chat history no longer disappears: new persistHistoryAcrossServers (on) keeps the buffer across world switches, disconnects and server changes, marking a session divider instead of clearing; new unlimitedChatHistory removes the entry cap

/b area now shows the floor and phase - 'F4 (clear)' / 'M7 (boss)' - from the scoreboard line plus [BOSS] chat, with the Watcher correctly excluded; new M4/F4 Etherwarp Helper highlights (27, 81, 18) during the F4/M4 boss fight

Auto Croesus no longer misclicks: chest slots are classified strictly by chest-interaction items, so it cannot click a loot item instead of 'Open Reward Chest', and a purchase is only counted once the click is verified
Auto Croesus no longer claims 'no profitable chests' while an Emerald chest is +515.6K - every non-bedrock chest is evaluated on real net profit
Chest modifiers are read from the Redstone Torch tooltip: a greyed/struck-through Kismet Feather or Dungeon Chest Key means that modifier was already spent on the chest
Auto dungeon key mode prices DUNGEON_CHEST_KEY from the live Bazaar and re-enters for a second chest when its profit beats key price + safety margin; kismet EV matches the Discord bot's !kismet maths

Itemised profit log: every chest opened (manual or automatic) records items + counts, floor/tier, run duration and net profit, synced to POST /api/v1/profits and browsable at /profits, /profit/:user and /profit/:user/:type; /b profit [user] shows it in game
Chest value panel gains a NET_ONLY / ITEMIZED display mode

Backpacks refresh when a container is opened (no more phantom 'Chimera in backpack 15'); /b storage <query> places chest waypoints in world, merges double chests, updates or removes them as items run out and purges verified-broken positions

/b egg no longer shows 'Active Subscription Area: None' on supported islands, collected eggs are remembered per spawn position across lobby hops, and pickup detection no longer depends on a fixed list of egg flavours
New /b apihistory (and /b apihistory chat): timestamp, service, method, endpoint, status and response time for every outbound HTTP/WebSocket request, with a log file
No Obfuscate is now line-aware: recombobulated rarity headers keep their obfuscation padding, while dummy markers like 'Obfuscated-3' are still revealed
Aspect of the Void always falls back to a valid vanilla model (no more purple/black missing texture), and the no-resource-pack toggle now actually bypasses pack models so vanilla overrides apply

/b pv shows load failures instead of the endless loading egg (no fake-ban limbo) and supports R to retry; tab completion covers lobby, friends, guild and party and rejects Hypixel's '!A-a' placeholder names; bigger window with a more transparent backdrop (configurable in GUI Settings)

Estimated Item Value can use Instant Buy (Lowest BIN) or Instant Sell (Bazaar Sell Offer / Average BIN), and now accounts for base item, stars, master stars, enchants, recombobulator, potato books, reforge, gemstones and attributes

Sequences: every step can now be edited in place - the pencil button loads the step back into the builder (including Run Chat / Command), so changing 'ah' into '/ah' no longer means deleting and recreating the step
Croesus profit tracker HUD (like /gp): total profit, runs, kismet count and a per-floor breakdown (F7 / M7 / M4 / T1...), movable and scalable in /b gui
Auto Croesus settings are now in the config GUI (Auto Croesus category, bomboclient build): thresholds, delays, kismet, dungeon keys, HUD toggles and the debug highlight switch
The chest value panel is movable/scalable in /b gui, with a sample panel to position it against
AutoCroesus simulation debug no longer repeats the same 'highlighted slot' line every tick - each slot/action is announced once per container (the outline still follows the real decision)
/b cmd history is saved to config/bomboaddons/cmd_history.txt and survives restarts (up arrow recalls it); every Bombo keybind is blocked while the terminal is open, so typing never fires a sequence
/b egg debug|auth|reconnect now exist and always run the handshake - they bypass the Hoppity-season gate, and the websocket connects as soon as the token arrives instead of staying 'Disconnected'

EggAuth no longer crashes with RuntimeException: the profile key pair is read through Minecraft's public getProfileKeyPairManager() instead of a broken accessor mixin, and failures print the real reason (offline account, expired key pair)
New Bombo auth server: POST /mod/auth on bomboapi - aaron-compatible Mojang key-pair verification issuing 6h Bombo tokens; GET /mod/auth/status shows pipeline health
EggFinder auth fallback chain: Skyblocker token -> hysky aaron -> Bombo auth, so /b egg works even when hysky refuses us
Hoppity waypoint writes now require a Bearer token (reads stay open); the mod attaches its token to every publish
Sequences actually run now: the executor ships in both builds (it was cheat-only, so pressing the trigger key did nothing); loop, jitter, repeats and safety halts all work
Click Slot / Item is one field: item name or slot number (5 / slot 5), plus an optional GUI Title guard so the step only fires inside the named GUI
Sequence editor: Ctrl+X cuts, long text scrolls inside its box instead of overflowing, taller action builder
/b cmd: typing while a command runs goes to its stdin (ssh ls works), Ctrl+C interrupts, and the view auto-follows output until you scroll up (End re-arms)
AutoCroesus debug: one summary per GUI visit (no spam) with a hoverable all-chests breakdown; the all-chests value panel now actually renders (its hook was orphaned)

EggFinder: full Skyblocker aaron authentication ported - profile key pair + SHA256withRSA signed data POST to hysky.de with a real token response, auto-refresh 5 min before expiry; fixes status: disconnected
Playtime sync: identifies as the mod (Java default UA was intermittently refused) with explicit timeouts
Chat history: keybind-fired commands keep their Keybind trigger through the deferred execution (pressing B for /bz no longer shows as Server)
Chat history: outgoing rows never show created-by null - keybind-fired commands show Source: BomboAddons with Trigger: Keybind <name>; typed ones show Player Input
Readable key names everywhere: key 258 is now Tab, plus arrows/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End/Insert/Delete/CapsLock in triggers, tooltips and capture buttons
Sequences category fixed on installs with a custom /b order: the organizer file is merged, not applied wholesale, so categories added in newer builds appear; Auto is now displayed as Sequences

/b cmd fixed: a duplicate registration made bare /b cmd run the legacy execute-last-command path; it now opens the terminal, whose session (scrollback, history, running command) survives closing - Ctrl+L clears
Mod ID hiding is always on now (both builds answer the brand query with the vanilla name); the toggle was removed
Updater refuses cross-Minecraft-line updates: a 26.1.x install can no longer update to a 26.2.x jar

Keybind capture supports modifier combos: Ctrl/Alt/Shift open a combo ([CTRL + ...] shown live) and a letter commits Ctrl+A etc.; releasing the modifier alone keeps a single-key bind - fixes Trade Max Pet Hotkey
Performance: Pest ESP only renders in the Garden; Critter Capsule trajectory only runs in the Safari (render and tick) - both rows vanish from /b perf elsewhere
AutoCroesus: new /b ac debug simulation mode (highlights instead of clicking), always-buy and worthless classification sets ported from RandomStuff, pet loot parsing, kismet blacklist respected
EggFinder websocket handshake now byte-matches Skyblocker: Bearer-prefixed aaron token and current Skyblocker/6.10.4 User-Agent (payload envelope already matched)

Account swapper: selection applies the session synchronously from the cached token, so a fast join can no longer connect as the previous account; partial swaps now warn in chat instead of failing silently

Fixed chat history attribution: server messages were labelled 'created by bomboaddons' because our own mixin/routing frames were picked as the caller - infrastructure frames are now skipped and network delivery is detected first

Chat history now merges the [BomboAddons] chat line into the feature event row, so 'Started auto sequence: X' shows Origin, Feature and Trigger (Keybind TAB, Mouse Button 5, Command /b auto run X, Config GUI RUN button) on hover
Chat history opens at the newest message with End/Home/PageUp/PageDown scrolling and no longer resets its scroll on tab change

Chat history tabs are now All, BomboAddons, Mods Only, Normal Chat (includes blocked), Blocked Only and Outgoing, plus an Events chip and a Source column; added /b chathistory bombo|mods|normal|blocked|outgoing|events|clear

Auto sequences are visible and editable in both builds again: the Auto category is no longer gated behind hideCheats and no longer cheat-only (only the executor is), so /b auto and the config card always exist
New auto step type: Right/Left Click NPC with name matcher, search radius and click button, for sequences like right-click NPC -> click slot -> shift-click -> close GUI
Auto sequences gained per-step Repeat counts, a randomised loop cooldown and a per-sequence jitter percentage (default 30) - a 3000ms delay fires between ~2100ms and ~3900ms
Auto sequence commands: /b auto add|remove|run|stop|list|toggle|loop|jitter|key <name> <KEY> - keybind and loop can be edited from chat
BUILD: ./gradlew build now produces BOTH artifacts at once - bomboaddons-<ver>.jar (legit) and bomboclient-<ver>.jar (cheat)
Added assertNoCheatReferences: the build fails if shared code references a cheat package (string literals/comments ignored so the reflective SPI stays legal)
assertFlavorIntegrity now also requires the cheat jar to contain its classes and marker, and stale -sources/-dev jars are deleted from build/libs automatically

Each build now uses its own Fabric mod id (bomboaddons / bomboclient) so a mod-id blacklist on one cannot affect the other; asset namespace is unchanged and a warning is shown if both jars are installed at once
New Hide Mod ID On Join setting (both builds, ON by default): the client answers the server brand query with the vanilla name so the join handshake carries no mod marker
New No Obfuscate setting (/b noobfuscate): strips the section-k scrambling style from chat messages and item lore so the hidden text is readable, keeping colours, formatting and click/hover events
New /b cmd in-game terminal: /b cmd ping 1.1.1.1 opens a real terminal screen and runs the command instantly, with streaming output, scrollback, up/down history, Ctrl+V paste and click-to-copy

Fixed updater reporting 'No releases or update jars found' when a build was simply up to date: the channel version is compared first and the flavor message is only shown for a real update that lacks an artifact for this build
Fixed /b chathistory: ChatHistoryScreen was implemented but never instantiated and no command existed - added /b chathistory, /b chathistory auto|all, a chatHistoryKey keybind and a config GUI button
Fixed a 2px render/click geometry mismatch in ChatHistoryScreen that made the bottom row unclickable, and clamped the scroll offset
Added ChatHistoryTracker.recordEvent with a new EVENT status so feature messages are no longer dropped by the [BomboAddons] filter
Auto sequence starts, stops, completions and halts are now recorded in chat history with their real trigger (Keybind TAB, Mouse Button 5, Config GUI RUN button, Command /b auto run)
Chat history tooltips now show Origin, Feature, Trigger and Sequence lines, plus a new Auto Sequences filter tab
Added /b auto list, /b auto run <name> and /b auto stop commands
Auto sequences now retry a failed step 3x before halting, with the reason recorded (container closed, slot not found, player left the world, sequence deleted, no steps)
Dual flavor build: ./gradlew build produces the legit bomboaddons jar and ./gradlew build -Pflavor=cheat produces bomboclient
Cheat-only sources moved to src/cheat/java behind a reflective FlavorBridge SPI so the legit jar never links a cheat type, enforced by a new assertFlavorIntegrity build task
Moved to cheat-only: the sequence executor, /b hide, the Auto category registration and a cheat-only ClientBrandRetriever mixin
Flavor-aware updater: /b update only installs the artifact matching the running flavor and old-jar cleanup is scoped per flavor; added /b update flavor and /b update switch
Added FlavorMigration that detects legacy cheat state (hideCheats=false or automation configured) and migrates it safely; config schema version bumped to 2
Added stealth mode (/b stealth) stopping bridge presence posts, egg publishing and modded brand advertisement, documented as identity hygiene rather than undetectability
Fixed .gitignore: a bare config/ pattern kept 5 build-critical gui/config sources out of version control - anchored to /config/ and tracked them
Added docs/FEATURE_AUDIT.md with the feature reachability audit, measured coverage numbers and the no-deletion policy
Added mod update channel setting ('Full Only' vs 'Betas & Full') in BomboConfig
Integrated channel filtering into /b update and background update checks
Enhanced /b update with subcommands: /b update full, /b update beta, and /b update channel <full|beta>
Added Update Channel cycle selector and Check For Updates button in Config GUI (General category)
Automated update downloads from api.bombo.dpdns.org/mod/version directly with proper jar naming and pending cleanup
Guarded custom SkyBlock item creation with SkyblockItemManager check in TotemAnimationManager to prevent vanilla items (such as lead) from showing missing stone textures
Fixed Ctrl+A in InventorySlotColorScreen to select all text with highlight rather than erasing it, plus added full Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo/redo history
Enhanced InventoryButtonsScreen text inputs with word deletion (Ctrl+Delete, Ctrl+Backspace), cursor navigation, clipboard shortcuts, and localized undo/redo
Aspect of the Void Base Texture Override in ItemModelResolverMixin to bypass broken warped variant texture overrides
Compact Chat History screen layout (13px rows) matching SkyHanni /shchathistory
Accurate mod origin detection in ChatHistoryTracker skipping Mixin generated and Minecraft proxy methods (Devonian, BomboAddons, SkyHanni, BetterPV, NEU, Odin, Skytils)
Captured blocked/suppressed messages via Fabric ClientReceiveMessageEvents GAME_CANCELED and CHAT_CANCELED in ChatHistoryTracker
Added interactive [Press Key...] keybind capture button for Clicker Trigger Keybind in ConfigCustomWidgets
New 'Auto' Automation Category and Sequence Manager (slot/item clicking, close GUI, run command, click in world/NPC, wait pauses, loop toggles, and hotkey listeners)
Minecraft 26.2 Fabric loader and mapping updates
Container slot color customizer enhancements
Inventory quick macro buttons system
Hypixel SkyBlock dynamic texturepack synchronization
Advanced chat history search and filtering
Restrict storage preview hover to storage containers only
Unified versioning system across build files
Etherwarp lore range check
Highlight search bar and category refinements
Diana lootshare recursion safety fix
